title: THE ARENA opens only when the hull is physically there (the 150 s timer gone; after three reminders Isao drives it out himself), the sector says what to do, SOL cuts a road planned once from the arena from the first second, and the gunship takes station over the arena
context: Owner, 2026-10-18, on Day-42@aa964d2a: 'sector 9, it's not quite clear what we must do. We should message it better, and I'd like the road there to be clear, we can clear via nukes and SOL. "Go investigate that area, I'll clear a way there". I believe it is not working because of the wrong triggers. It should be 1) Tank must go investigate. 2) there is a clear fast path (cleared by nukes and SOL) to the investigation better. 2) the tank reaches a huge sinkhole, which becomes, with a very large area around it, the ARENA. The Arena is where the gunship circles. That series of events, and waiting for the tank to be physically there, is what triggers the Boss, Ni daihra.' The probe before any fix (a headless run of ?skip=defence&sector=8&boss=1 without arenaNow): the arena opened at 149.x s on ARENA.waitMax with the hull still at the base 273 cells away; the sector card said ON THE GATE SIDE; the gunship circled the base because the arena's spawn point exists only once the hole opens; the road never fired because day-42 (branched from main) still carried the road's first version while the working second version (be31cee7, 2026-10-16) sat on the unmerged integrate-2026-10-16 branch; the hull wedged twice in corridors on the drive (the wedge fix 7e847c5c likewise unmerged).
outcome: Brief arena_go as the sector begins ('Something big is moving out there. Go and investigate that tremor. I'll clear a way.', src/isaobriefs.js), the callout INVESTIGATE THE TREMOR at the start and every ARENA.remind 40 s while the hull's road distance has not dropped, the card FAR OUT, AT THE TREMOR; arenaDue opens the hole only within ARENA.reachCells or by the harness's force(): waitMax is removed, and after ARENA.remindMax 3 reminders Isao says arena_drive ('Fine. I'll drive. Keep your eyes on the tremor.') and puts the hull on the lure directive so it still physically arrives (the player may take the wheel back); the road is planned once from the arena's cell (src/domain/arena.js roadField/roadPath/roadRock, a Dijkstra over rock-weighted cells) and SOL cuts its rocks from the first second, SOL CUTS THE ROAD once when the first cut lands, blue rings 4, 8 and 12 cells ahead of the hull along it, the road's pass closed when the beacon phase ends so the automated aim is free for the Reeds; be31cee7 (the road's second version: shortcuts worth ARENA.road.saves cells, the arsenal's road target, the beam's clear by the chord, the unsafe guard over the friends) and 7e847c5c (the wedge at rocket-b: thread clearance) brought over whole from integrate-2026-10-16, with the wedge's entry 2026-10-16-the-wedge-at-rocket-b-a-waist; the gunship takes station over the arena at the sector's start (placeOver) and is placed back over the heart at SECURE; the forced gunship seat waits for Isao's hand-over line; the integrity strip's row no longer says the gate is at half as the arena's Reeds die. Harness: state().boss.road { planned, path, asks, cell, laid, wired }, roadCuts; --arena asserts arena_go, the callout, the planned road and a cut within 12 s and the hole shut before arenaNow(); --arena-drive drives the hull along the road and watches the hole stay shut beyond reachCells and open within it.
alternatives: A long safety timer (600 s) opening the hole regardless: the owner's premise is the tank physically there; Isao driving keeps it and ends the hang.

Taking the whole integrate-2026-10-16 branch into day-42: it carries refactor rounds 2 and 3 (td-tab 6,181 -> 5,551, about 3,900 lines moved) that the owner has not playtested; the two fixes were cherry-picked whole instead, and a later merge is expected to conflict at td-tab's createBossRun literal.
The MK-9 as a second road cutter ('cleared by nukes and SOL'): SOL clears the road's three rocks on the shipped planet in about 10 s; the nuke stays a proposal.
evidence: the probe's findings and timings in the session's r2-d report (headless, ?skip=defence&sector=8&boss=1, 165 s parked: the hole never opened; driving the road: the hole opened with the hull there at 86 s, 21 cuts)

test/boss-run.mjs (a fake controller: the order of briefs, the hull-only trigger, the reminders and Isao's drive), test/arena.mjs (the planned road), test/integrity-hud.mjs; npm test; npm run architecture (td-tab 6,184)

scripts/browser-test.mjs --arena (4 steps: arena_go on the panel, the callout, the planned road and a cut at 2.6 s, due false before arenaNow), --arena-drive (the hull driven along state().boss.road.path: the hole opened at 93.5 s with the hull 7.8 cells out, the Reeds 9 s later), --arena-road, --laser-game, --corridor-probe, --round13 green on r2-d; merged into day-42

open: the road's rings can lead the hull into a corner two cells out of the base (the drive step backs out after 3 s stuck, a player may not); Isao's drive follows the open-ground field, not the planned road; SOL's automated aim after the road pass (overhead 45 -> 3.5 s) is not checked in a browser; a hull lost at the arena before the boss rises redeploys at the base while the boss comes; the integrate branch's other pieces (the nest Reed's body 85bcb426, refactor rounds 2-3) stay off day-42 pending the owner's call
